SASBDB entry SASDUP5  (https://www.sasbdb.org/data/SASDUP5/)

Inosine-5'-monophosphate dehydrogenase (IMPDH) of Mycobacterium smegmatis, octamer,
"ATP-bound form", 20 degC. The SASBDB buffer field reads 50 mM HEPES, 200 mM KCl, 2 mM MgCl2,
0.5 mM TCEP, pH 7.5 (the same for the apo, IMP, ATP+IMP and GTP entries of the series); the
PAPER gives the actual sample: 50 mM HEPES pH 7.4, 200 mM KCl, 0.5 mM TCEP, 10 mM ATP and
MgCl2 in a 2 mM excess over the nucleotide (12 mM), Methods "Small angle X-ray scattering" and
Fig. 4f legend ("(blue) with 10 mM ATP"). The script follows the paper.
Publication: Bulvas O et al., Nat Commun 2024, DOI 10.1038/s41467-024-50933-6 (PDF consulted,
its supplement not available).
Files:
  experimental_data/SASDUP5.dat    SASBDB media/intensities_files (q in nm^-1)
  SASDUP5_fit1.fit                 SASBDB media/fitting_files (CRYSOL 2.8.3, q in A^-1)
  SASDUP5_fit1_model1.pdb          SASBDB media/pdb_file (octamer model, protein only,
                                   with hydrogens)
One fit (CRYSOL, header chi2 2.433 = SASBDB). No file was modified.

Fit range (2026-11-13): the script cuts at q = 0.2 1/A (flat noise floor: above it 342 points, median I/sigma -0.06, 53 % I <= 0).
